bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/compose.rs (midi(), pitches()), springboard/apps/daw/src/dsp.rs (mtof), springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (Bluetooth management socket, audio-class devices only)
summary: The MIDI stack: UMP and MIDI 1.0 messages, an endpoint registry and routing hub, thru transforms, BLE MIDI packets, MIDI-CI discovery and Property Exchange, and RTP-MIDI session packets exist as pure models with host unit tests. Since 2026-10-19 bifrost-midid also serves a client socket (rawmidi input and output, hotplug, virtual endpoints, thru connections) and apps reach it through bifrost_app::midi_client, with a bifrost-midi command-line tool. Not wired: BLE GATT, RTP-MIDI sockets, kernel UMP endpoints; nothing is verified on Midget yet. Note-number math in the DAW is one small use of the models.

features.feature: MIDI Services (clients, ports, device and entity lookup)
features.apple: MIDIClientCreate, MIDIInputPortCreateWithProtocol, MIDIOutputPortCreate, MIDIGetNumberOfDevices, MIDIPortConnectSource, MIDIReceiveBlock (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremidi/midi-services)
features.bifrost: springboard/audio/midi/src/endpoints.rs (Registry: clients, devices, entities, endpoints, connections), springboard/audio/midi/src/hub.rs (routing), springboard/audio/midid/ (ALSA rawmidi and seq, BLE link); springboard/audio/midi/src/wire.rs; springboard/audio/midi/src/broker.rs; springboard/audio/midid/src/server.rs; springboard/sdk/src/midi_client.rs (MidiClient); springboard/cmd/src/midictl.rs (bifrost-midi); packaging/arch/bifrost-midid.service
features.note: Built 2026-10-19 (tests unrun): clients, ports and lookup work against the running daemon. bifrost-midid listens on /run/bifrost/audio/is.olibuijr.midi.sock (bifrost_midi::wire frames, bifrost_midi::broker over the Hub, tested without a socket); MidiClient says hello, lists devices, entities, sources and destinations with their connections, connects sources (one input port per client), creates and disposes virtual sources and destinations, sends and injects timestamped UMP packets or MIDI 1.0 bytes, receives packets in host-time order and is told when the setup changed; limits are enforced and a misbehaving client is dropped with its endpoints. bifrost-midid.service ships with the package. Not built: several input ports per client, MIDITimeStamp ticks (host-clock nanoseconds are used), shm event rings into the audio server. Midget check: `systemctl status bifrost-midid` is active, `bifrost-midi list` shows the connected USB MIDI devices with source and destination ids, and `bifrost-midi monitor 20` prints `NS name 2090XXYY` lines when keys are pressed.

features.feature: MIDI System Setup (driver and external device management)
features.bifrost: springboard/audio/midi/src/endpoints.rs (Registry: add_device, add_entity, remove_entity, remove_external_device); springboard/audio/midid/src/main.rs (open_hardware, hotplug); springboard/audio/midi/src/broker.rs (setup_changed)
features.note: Built 2026-10-19 (tests unrun): the hotplug path. midid rescans /dev/snd every two seconds, adds a device with an entity and a source and/or destination only for the directions the node supports, removes the device (with its queue and thru connections) when its port fails, and tells every client with a SetupChanged event so it lists again. There is no driver list and no driver plug-ins (the kernel ALSA drivers are the drivers). Midget check: run `bifrost-midi monitor 60` and unplug then replug the USB keyboard: the new source is connected without restarting the tool and events resume; `bifrost-midi list` shows the device gone while it is unplugged.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/midi_ble.rs (SysExAssembler); springboard/audio/midi/src/ble.rs (BLE MIDI packet framing); springboard/sdk/src/ble_midi.rs; springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-09.rs
features.note: BLE MIDI packet encode and decode with timestamps and MTU splitting (audio/midi/src/ble.rs), and SysExAssembler joins system exclusive messages that span packets, both tested headless. The system layer pairs and tracks Bluetooth devices and classifies audio-class devices. Gap: GATT service discovery on the live link is not verified, and it needs a Bluetooth peripheral on the lab machine.

features.apple: MIDI1UPNoteOn, MIDI1UPControlChange, MIDI2NoteOn, MIDI2PitchBend, MIDIMessage_32, MIDIMessage_64 (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremidi/midi-messages)
features.bifrost: springboard/audio/midi/src/ump.rs (UMP and MIDI 1.0 conversion, SysEx), springboard/audio/midi/src/events.rs (MIDI 1.0 parser and encoder), springboard/apps/daw/src/model.rs:152 (note struct); springboard/sdk/src/midi_client.rs (send, send_bytes, inject); springboard/audio/midi/src/wire.rs (packet validation)
features.note: Built 2026-10-19 (tests unrun): UMP and MIDI 1.0 bytes both travel through the server: MidiClient::send and inject take UMP packets, send_bytes and inject_bytes convert MIDI 1.0 bytes (running status, system exclusive) to UMP, the wire checks that a packet's word count matches its message type, and hardware destinations get MIDI 1.0 bytes through UmpToMidi1. The DAW note model still stores only pitch and velocity. Midget check: `bifrost-midi send USB 90 3C 64` then `bifrost-midi send USB 80 3C 00` starts and releases a note on a connected USB synth (`bifrost-midi note USB 60` does both).

features.feature: Note number to pitch and frequency
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 13 tests. Covers note names (C#4, Bb2) to note numbers and note numbers to Hz. The per-note attribute types (pitch, manufacturer-specific, profile-specific) have no counterpart.

features.feature: MIDI Thru Connection (play-through, value maps, transforms)
features.bifrost: springboard/audio/midi/src/thru.rs (ValueMap, ControlTransform, ThruConnection), springboard/audio/midi/src/hub.rs (routing between sources and destinations); springboard/audio/midi/src/broker.rs (route, thru_packet); springboard/sdk/src/midi_client.rs (create_thru)
features.note: Built 2026-10-19 (tests unrun): thru connections run inside the server (ThruCreate, ThruEnable, ThruDispose; MidiClient::create_thru): channel filter, note and velocity value maps, control rewrites; MIDI 1.0 and 2.0 packets keep their type and other messages pass; a connection ends when its client disconnects or an endpoint goes away. Midget check: with a USB keyboard and a USB synth, `bifrost-midi thru Keys Synth 30 12` plays the synth an octave above what you play for 30 s.

NetworkSession, Host, Connection, ConnectionPolicy and RTP-MIDI session packets (IN, OK, NO, BY) with host unit tests; disconnect returns the BY packet for an accepted invitation and disable ends every connection. Headless tests: sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-11.rs (leaving_a_connection_sends_an_end_packet_for_its_invitation, disabling_the_session_ends_every_connection_and_stops_invitations). Gap: no sockets or mDNS discovery, so sessions cannot reach a real host; this needs the network and a check on Midget, and the shell is not wired.

features.feature: MIDI Drivers (driver plug-ins and device lists)
features.note: The Apple driver plug-in model is specific to macOS. The Linux counterpart would be the kernel ALSA sequencer, which BifrOSt does not use for MIDI.

features.feature: MIDI Capability Inquiry (MIDI-CI discovery, profiles, property exchange)
features.note: Built 2026-10-19 (tests unrun): a transport. SysexCollector joins system exclusive packets into whole messages and MidiCiLink runs the DiscoveryManager over the MIDI server (discover, profile inquiry, answering inquiries). Still no property exchange subscriptions. Midget check: `bifrost-midi ci <destination> <source> 5` against a MIDI-CI capable device prints `device 0123456: manufacturer ..., model ...`; with none it prints `no MIDI-CI device answered`.

gaps: Not verified on Midget: the device path (ALSA rawmidi in and out) and the client socket are built (bifrost-midid, MidiClient) but the BLE GATT link is not.
MIDI-CI has a transport over the MIDI server (MidiCiLink) but no subscription messages and no property exchange over a live link.
No MIDI network sockets or mDNS discovery; the RTP-MIDI session packets are not sent or received.
Hotplug is a two-second rescan of /dev/snd in midid (SetupChanged to clients), not a udev or kernel event; not verified on Midget.
The DAW note model stores only pitch and velocity (springboard/apps/daw/src/model.rs:152); control change and pitch bend are not used by the DAW.
The app-facing API is bifrost_app::midi_client (MidiClient); the DAW does not use it yet.
